fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix (SKHY) and Micron (MU) are the 2nd and 3rd largest memory chip manufacturers globally, surging during 2024-2025 HBM growth but declining sharply in recent two months.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK Hynix expects 2025 revenue increase of 47%, net income increase of 117%, and 2026 projected revenue increase of 275%; Micron expects 2026 fiscal year revenue to triple and net income to increase 10-fold, showing solid growth.
